description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'NativeLibrary' responsible for loading the native TensorFlow JNI library. It manages extracting the library from resources within the JAR, handling different OS and architecture-specific names, and ensuring the native code is loaded before use. The class provides methods to load the library, check if it's already loaded, and handle versioned library names.

classes.name: NativeLibrary
classes.description: Helper class for loading the TensorFlow Java native library. Manages resource extraction, OS and architecture detection, and loading the correct library version.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Main method to load the TensorFlow JNI native library. Checks if already loaded, tries loading from system library path or extracts from resources if necessary.

methods.name: tryLoadLibrary
methods.description: Attempts to load the native library using System.loadLibrary.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the native library is already loaded by invoking TensorFlow.version().

methods.name: getMajorVersionNumber
methods.description: Reads the TensorFlow version info file to determine the major version number for library naming.

methods.name: makeResourceName
methods.description: Constructs the resource path for native libraries based on OS and architecture.

methods.name: extractResource
methods.description: Extracts a resource InputStream to a temporary file for loading.
